items.title: The humanoid of the future: a Chinese body with an American brain
items.summary: NVIDIA robotics lead Spencer Huang describes a reference humanoid combining a Chinese-built body with US AI compute, aimed at standardising research platforms.

items.title: Best robot vacuums of June 2026 — Dreame X60 holds top spot as Ecovacs and Roborock close in
items.summary: The Dreame X60 Max Ultra remains rated best overall, with the Ecovacs X12 OmniCyclone and Roborock Saros 20 close behind as flagship features move down-market.

items.title: NVIDIA unveils open Isaac GR00T reference humanoid — Unitree H2 body, Sharpa hands, Jetson Thor brain
items.summary: NVIDIA announced its first open humanoid reference design, pairing a Unitree H2 Plus body and Sharpa five-fingered hands with Jetson Thor compute and the Isaac GR00T platform for researchers.

items.title: Can surgical robots fly? SS Innovations details its Vimana Aero battlefield drone
items.summary: SS Innovations aims for a functional flying surgical robot by mid-2026, designed to bring telesurgery to wounded soldiers in active battle zones.

items.title: Top tech news: NVIDIA extends humanoid partnerships across US, Europe and South Korea
items.summary: NVIDIA said it will work with humanoid makers in the US, Europe and South Korea alongside Unitree, integrating Blackwell compute and built-in cybersecurity.

items.title: Humanoid robotics in 2026: SoftBank buys ABB robotics for $5.4B as the race scales
items.summary: A market overview of 2026 humanoid commercialisation: SoftBank acquiring ABB robotics, Hexagon piloting its AEON robot at a Leipzig plant, and Qualcomm launching a humanoid-specific processor.

items.title: DJI ROMO 2 robot vacuum confirmed to launch May 11 — 25,000 Pa and dual edge arms
items.summary: DJI brings drone-grade LiDAR and fisheye navigation to its second-gen ROMO vacuum, with up to 25,000 Pa suction and dual robotic edge-cleaning arms.

items.title: Tesla to release mass-production Optimus V3 as the humanoid "Model 3 moment" nears
items.summary: Tesla is set to release its mass-production Optimus V3, targeting million-unit production lines by end of 2026, as Chinese makers deploy humanoids in logistics.

items.title: CES 2026 vacuum wars: Ecovacs debuts a pool cleaner and Lil Milo companion; MOVA flies a vacuum
items.summary: CES 2026 cleaning highlights: Ecovacs revealed its first robotic pool cleaner and a pet-like companion robot, while MOVA showed a concept drone module to fly a vacuum.

items.title: 9 humanoid robots at CES 2026 that showed the future is already here
items.summary: CES 2026 marked humanoids moving from demos to deployment: Boston Dynamics showed a production electric Atlas, AgiBot launched Genie Sim 3.0, and NEURA revealed a 3rd-gen 4NE1.
